goalText: Your goal is to understand the user's needs, challenges, and context well enough to recommend relevant solutions from our app catalog. You do this by having a brief, focused conversation that gathers the key information defined in the checklist below.

radarDimensions.label: Goal Clarity
radarDimensions.description: How well we understand the user's primary objective and what they want to achieve

radarDimensions.label: Use Case Specificity
radarDimensions.description: How specific and concrete the user's use case or scenario is

radarDimensions.label: Technical Context
radarDimensions.description: Understanding of the user's technical sophistication and existing infrastructure

radarDimensions.label: Business Context
radarDimensions.description: Understanding of industry, company size, role, and organizational constraints

radarDimensions.label: Urgency & Timeline
radarDimensions.description: How urgent the need is and what timeline the user is working within

radarDimensions.label: Budget Constraints
radarDimensions.description: Understanding of budget expectations and financial constraints

checklist.label: Primary Goal
checklist.description: What is the user trying to accomplish? What problem are they trying to solve?

checklist.label: Current Situation
checklist.description: What is the user currently doing? What's not working? What manual processes exist?

checklist.label: Industry & Role
checklist.description: What industry does the user work in? What is their role?

checklist.label: Company Size
checklist.description: How large is the organization? (solo, small team, mid-size, enterprise)

checklist.label: Technical Sophistication
checklist.description: What is the user's technical comfort level? Do they have developer resources?

checklist.label: Timeline
checklist.description: When does the user need a solution? How urgent is this?

checklist.label: Budget Awareness
checklist.description: What is the user's budget range or price sensitivity? (optional but helpful)

checklist.label: Success Criteria
checklist.description: How will the user know if a solution is working? What does success look like?
